# btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text (Resource)

Manages a Secret Text credential in the SAP BTP CI/CD service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "btpservice_cicd_credential_secret_text" "example" {
  name        = "my-api-token"
  description = "API token for accessing an external service"
  text        = "my-secret-api-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `name` (String) Credential name Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and dots.
- `text` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The secret text value. Write-only; never stored in Terraform state.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional human-readable description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the resource (assigned by the API).
